{{Quote|My family could be in that camp, I'm going in!|Lutin Hollis during the liberation of Camp Four|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
'''Lutin Hollis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a veteran [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He was captured by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] but later rescued and went on to fight against the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]].

==Biography==
Lutin Hollis, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], spent his youth in the hills of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] on his family's small [[Farm/Legends|farm]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo website">{{LucasArts|url=products/naboo/index_ie.html|text=''Star Wars: Battle for Naboo''}}</ref> He then spent time traveling the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in search of experience and adventure.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> By the time of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of Naboo, he was an accomplished pilot.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo website" /> Hollis was captured in the opening stages of the invasion. When he was rescued from his prison camp, he joined a [[Naboo Resistance|resistance band]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> The captain was later shot down in battle, and Hollis reported this fact to his fellow resistance member, [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]]. Hollis then joined in the [[Search for Captain Kael|search]] for Kael, eventually locating the captain's fighter. Kael revealed with his dying breath that their [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] ally [[Borvo]] the Hutt had betrayed him. Sykes swore revenge against the Hutt. Hollis and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] [[Vedd Deviss]] flanked the Hutt's position on [[Porso Hill]], protecting Sykes while he [[Attack on Porso Hill|engaged]] the [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|Hutt's personal transport]]. After Borvo was forced to flee, the resistance turned their sights back to the Trade Federation.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Acting on information provided by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] pilot [[Kol Kotha]], they planned on [[Liberation of Camp Four|liberating]] [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]]. Flying under cover of darkness, the pilots flew into the camp. Hollis broke formation, thinking his family might be in the camp. His actions exposed their position to the enemy. Sykes was able to infiltrate the camp and liberate the prisoners. Hollis performed a strafing run, firing on several [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]] which were threatening Sykes; Hollis succeeded in blowing up part of the wall, allowing Sykes to reach a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> He had a son, [[Reyé Hollis/Legends|Reyé Hollis]], who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" />

==Personality and traits==
Hollis was a capable pilot, flying the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] into battle. He was also rash at times, but rejoined the formation afterward.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> He was willing to take risks to protect his friends and family and to stop the Trade Federation.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo website" /> He was also the third pilot (P3) on the Queen's Royal Starship behind Ric Olié.

==Behind the scenes==
Lutin Hollis was portrayed by [[Philip Delancy]]<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-i-the-phantom-menace/philip-delancy-lutin-hollis|text=Philip Delancy (Lutin Hollis)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|date=2010-03|archivedate=20200716040351|nolive=1}}</ref> in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and voiced by [[Steve McPartlin]] in the [[2000]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. He later received an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''and the [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']].
